10-banana-wars-honduras.txt.title: The Rippling Effects of The Banana Wars in Honduras
10-banana-wars-honduras.txt.notes: 30 real oral history interviews with Honduran participants ages 37-60. Mixed methods case study. Thematic coding into 7 groups with participant counts and percentages. Consent forms and full interview transcripts in appendix. Genuine field research. Main weaknesses are asserted gap and mostly non-peer-reviewed sources. Spanish-language quote from Participant 20 must not trigger non-English penalty.
